responsibility: Declares the public interface for GCC’s HTML diagnostics output format. It defines html_generation_options, including resource toggles and debugging controls for diagnostic state diagrams, and exposes the helpers for opening an HTML output file, constructing an HTML diagnostic_output_format sink, and rendering a diagnostic_path as HTML, serving as the declaration layer consumed by the option-spec parser and other diagnostics code.
same_name_distinction: Declares the HTML diagnostics interface and option struct used by other diagnostics code to request HTML output. Unlike gcc/diagnostic-format-html.cc, it contains declarations only—such as html_generation_options, HTML sink/file-opening entry points, and path-printing APIs—rather than the HTML builder, output-format implementation, or selftests.
